definitions.ask: Which chord should open the Copy card's code picker from Highlights?
definitions.why: Single modifier like ⌘Y and ⌘L; collides with nothing in Highlights 2026.1.2 or the panel

choices.label: Command-B ("block"); one modifier like ⌘Y/⌘L; unbound in Highlights and the Refs panel
Control-Command-C keeps the C mnemonic; two modifiers, among Highlights' ⌃⌘ tools

definitions.ask: On references without saved Markdown, should ⌘L copy their Markdown link at once, exactly like ⌘Y L?
definitions.why: The chord then saves exactly one keypress and never has a second meaning

choices.label: ⌘L always equals ⌘Y L; such references copy [Title](source URL) at once
⌘L always means the link picker; such references show the red no-saved-Markdown line

definitions.ask: Also offer Command-C as an opt-in code key in Settings, though it replaces Highlights' Edit › Copy?
definitions.why: Highlights' ⌘C copies selected PDF text, and a Carbon hotkey cannot pass the key through
